full_sources.ua_card_lang_job.py:
"""Keeps the card language versions in step with the CRM pages (CARD-LANG-001): a CRM bot job, once a minute.

Under the existing publication fence (never during a publication): ua_card_lang.reconcile for the cards the
catalogue publishes; when a version was written or removed, ua_seo_index.refresh renews the sitemap and tells
IndexNow and Google, as after a publication. A failure is logged and retried next minute; it never touches
the CRM or blocks a publication.
"""
import asyncio
import logging
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/Carix/video')
NAME = 'card-lang-versions'
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def run(root=ROOT):
    from publication_fence import publication_fence
    import ua_card_lang
    import ua_seo_sitemap
    with publication_fence(timeout=5.0):
        published = ua_seo_sitemap.CatalogLinks((root/'katalog.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')).names
        result = ua_card_lang.reconcile(root, published)
        try:  # KOREA-RU-001: the Russian Korea page follows korea.html
            import ua_korea_ru
            result['written'] += ua_korea_ru.reconcile(root)['written']
        except Exception as error:
            result['failed']['korea.html'] = type(error).__name__ + ':' + str(error)[:160]
        if result['written'] or result['removed']:
            import ua_seo_index
            result['seo_index'] = ua_seo_index.refresh(root)
    return result


async def job(context):
    try:
        result = await asyncio.to_thread(run)
    except Exception as error:
        log.warning('Языковые версии карточек: %s: %s', type(error).__name__, str(error)[:160])
        return
    if result['written'] or result['removed'] or result['incomplete'] or result['failed']:
        log.info('Языковые версии карточек: %s', {k: v for k, v in result.items() if v})


def schedule(app):
    if app.job_queue is None:
        raise RuntimeError('JobQueue is required')
    if not app.job_queue.get_jobs_by_name(NAME):
        app.job_queue.run_repeating(job, interval=60, first=30, name=NAME,
                                    job_kwargs={'max_instances': 1, 'coalesce': True})

1] + column def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs): start = self.position() raw = self.get_starttag_text() node = dict(tag=tag, attrs=dict(attrs), start=start, open_end=start+len(raw), end=start+len(raw), inner_end=start+len(raw), text=[]) self.nodes.append(node) if tag not in VOID: self.stack.append(node) def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs): self.handle_starttag(tag, attrs) if self.stack and self.stack[-1]['tag'] == tag: self.stack.pop() def handle_endtag(self, tag): for i in range(len(self.stack)-1, -1, -1): if self.stack[i]['tag'] == tag: node = self.stack[i] node['inner_end'] = self.position() node['end'] = self.source.index('>', self.position()) + 1 del self.stack[i:] break def handle_data(self, value): for node in self.stack: if node['tag'] in ('title', 'h1', 'td'): node['text'].append(value) def select(self, tag): return [n for n in self.nodes if n['tag'] == tag] def text(node): return ' '.join(''.join(node['text']).split()) def page_name(source): doc = Document(source) for node in doc.select('link'): if 'canonical' in (node['attrs'].get('rel') or '').lower().split(): name = PurePath(urlsplit(node['attrs'].get('href', '')).path).name if name in CORE: return name if CARD.fullmatch(name): return '' title = ' '.join(text(n) for n in doc.select('title')).lower() if 'каталог' in title: return 'katalog.html' if any(word in title for word in ('подбор', 'под заказ', 'замовлення')): return 'podbor.html' if any(word in title for word in ('услов', 'информац', 'умови')): return 'info.html' return 'index.html' if 'ua art company' in title else '' def localized(values, suffix=''): return ''.join(' data-%s%s="%s"' % (lang, suffix, escape(value, quote=True)) for lang, value in values.items()) def core_metadata(name): values = { 'index.html': ( ('Авто из Кореи под ключ и под заказ — Киев, Украина | UA ART COMPANY', 'Авто з Кореї під ключ і під замовлення — Київ, Україна | UA ART COMPANY'), ('Подбор, проверка, доставка и оформление автомобилей. Каталог авто в наявності й у дорозі, замовлення автомобіля з-за кордону — UA ART COMPANY, Київ.')), 'katalog.html': ( ('Каталог авто в наличии и в пути — UA ART COMPANY', 'Каталог авто в наявності й у дорозі — UA ART COMPANY'), ('Каталог автомобилей UA ART COMPANY: фото, характеристики, цены и текущий этап доставки. Укажите страну, модель и бюджет в заявке UA ART COMPANY для обсуждения подбора и доставки.', 'Підбір автомобіля з Кореї, США, Японії та інших країн. 'stage': int(stage.group(1)) if stage else None, 'image': urljoin(ORIGIN + '/video/', urlsplit(image).path.replace('/m/', '/')) if image else '', 'year': int(year.group(0)) if year else None, 'key': titles, {'ru': ru, 'uk': uk}, model def card_links(facts): """Links from a card to its model page and the hub, both languages; no other car codes.""" links = [] if facts['key']: name =
